justification: Cumulative release delta through 0.7.0. The new owner-call surface ships as package/server version 0.7.0, and serverInfo.version follows the VERSION const.

Cumulative through 0.7.0: after_hours_confirmation remains on business/direct calls, and call_me is now registered with a real owner-only message/mode/wait schema. It has no destination field and keeps the full rail contract in its description. Then: bounded dial tools (wait:false + get_call polling) for MCP hosts with short tool-call timeouts — make_call and call_number gain an optional wait property (default true = unchanged blocking behavior) whose description forbids re-dialing and points at get_call.
expectContains: false returns immediately after the dial is placed, with a call_id to poll via get_call
never re-invoke make_call for the same ask
never re-invoke call_number for the same ask

justification: v0.5.1 M2 (issue #37): an unknown subcommand now prints usage to stderr and exits 2 instead of booting the stdio server (the 0.4.9 baseline locked the bug: code 13 + full server boot, which hung agent shells on a typo).

0.5.4 adds the `call report|events|transcript` CLI command. Bare `call` (no subcommand) prints usage to stderr and exits 2 with NO network call — deterministic offline. No 0.4.9 baseline exists (the command is new); asserted via delta per the suite's frozen-baseline rule.

Cumulative through 0.7.0: readiness keeps the plain-language status and now reports local call_me owner availability plus the enforced client profile. With no owner profile, it returns the exact speko me verify setup path and safe-default poll behavior, and adds the headless path: portable owner state for headless installs (me export / SPEKO_OWNER_PROFILE).
